---
title: "Palaeoverse dashboard"
logo: _brand/logos/logo.png
format:
  dashboard:
    nav-buttons:
      # Every metric of every package, written by fetch.R and published
      # alongside the dashboard (see `resources` in _quarto.yml)
      - icon: download
        text: Download data
        href: data/metrics.csv
      - icon: github
        href: https://github.com/palaeoverse/palaeoverse.dashboard
    include-after-body:
      # Download metrics.csv instead of opening its content in the tab.
      text: |
        <script>
          document
            .querySelectorAll('a[href="data/metrics.csv"]')
            .forEach((a) => a.setAttribute("download", "metrics.csv"));
        </script>
author: "Last updated: `r as.character(format(Sys.time()))`"

theme:
  - cosmo
  - brand
  - custom.scss

execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
library(bslib)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gh)
library(cranlogs)
library(reactable)
library(echarts4r)
library(mapgl)
library(tidyr)

source("stats.R")

pkgs <- c("palaeoverse", "rmacrostrat", "rphylopic", "sepkoski")

fmt <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",")

# One value box of a package tab. They all have the same shape: a title, an
# icon, and the current value of one metric, optionally linking somewhere.
vbox <- function(title, icon, value, href = NULL) {
  value <- fmt(value)
  if (!is.null(href)) {
    value <- paste0("[", value, "](", href, "){target=\"_blank\"}")
  }
  cat(
    "::: {.valuebox title=\"", title, "\" icon=\"", icon, "\"",
    " color=\"primary\" expandable=\"false\"}\n",
    value,
    "\n:::\n",
    sep = ""
  )
}

# A card title followed by an info icon that explains the metric on hover.
# Used as `#| title: !expr title_tip(...)` in a dashboard cell.
title_tip <- function(title, tip) {
  paste(title, as.character(bslib::tooltip(bsicons::bs_icon("info-circle"), tip)))
}

# One "icon + value + label" stat, shown in the overview card's stats grid.
overview_stat <- function(icon, value, label, pkg = NULL) {
  label <- switch(
    label,
    "open issues" = paste0(
      "<a href='https://github.com/palaeoverse/", pkg, "/issues' target='_blank'>",
      label, 
      "</a>"
    ),
    "open PRs" = paste0(
      "<a href='https://github.com/palaeoverse/", pkg, "/pulls' target='_blank'>",
      label, 
      "</a>"
    ),
    "contributors" = paste0(
      "<a href='https://github.com/palaeoverse/", pkg, "/contributors' target='_blank'>",
      label, 
      "</a>"
    ),
    label
  ) 
  paste0(
    "<div class=\"overview-stat\">",
    as.character(bsicons::bs_icon(icon)),
    "<span class=\"overview-stat-value\">",
    fmt(value),
    "</span>",
    "<span class=\"overview-stat-label\">",
    label,
    "</span></div>"
  )
}

# Body of one overview card: CRAN check status, the R-CMD-check badge, the
# Codecov badge (all built in stats.R) and a small grid of repository stats.
# The card itself and its header (the package name) are provided by the
# dashboard cell + its `title` option.
pkg_overview_card <- function(pkg) {
  last_release <- latest_release(pkg)
  htmltools::HTML(paste0(
    "<div class=\"overview-cran\"><strong>CRAN checks:</strong> ",
    latest_cran_checks(pkg),
    "</div>",
    "<span class=\"last-cran-update\"><strong>Last CRAN release:</strong><br>",
    last_release[["date"]],
    " (",
    last_release[["n_weeks"]],
    " weeks ago) ",
    "</span>",
    "<div class=\"overview-badges\">",
    "<span>",
    badge_ci(pkg),
    "</span>",
    "<span>",
    badge_coverage(pkg),
    "</span>",
    "<span>",
    badge_pkgdown(pkg),
    "</span>",
    "</div>",
    "<div class=\"overview-stats\">",
    "<div class=\"overview-stats-row\">",
    overview_stat("people", get_latest(pkg, "contributors"), "contributors"),
    overview_stat("diagram-2", get_latest(pkg, "forks"), "forks"),
    "</div>",
    "<div class=\"overview-stats-row\">",
    overview_stat(
      "exclamation-circle",
      get_latest(pkg, "open_issues"),
      "open issues", 
      pkg = pkg
    ),
    overview_stat(
      "git", 
      get_latest("palaeoverse", "open_pull_requests"), 
      "open PRs", 
      pkg = pkg
    ),
    "</div>",
    "</div>"
  ))
}

other_overview_card <- function(repo, workflow1, workflow2) {
  htmltools::HTML(paste0(
    "<div class=\"overview-badges\">",
    "<span>",
    .badge(repo, workflow1),
    "</span><span>",
    .badge(repo, workflow2),
    "</span>",
    "</div>"
  ))
}
```

### Column {.overview-charts width="50%"}

```{r}
#| title: Cumulative number of CRAN downloads
series <- lapply(pkgs, function(pkg) {
  out <- package_time_series(pkg)[["cran_downloads"]][c("date", "value")]
  names(out)[2] <- pkg
  out
})

Reduce(function(x, y) full_join(x, y, by = "date"), series) |>
  arrange(date) |> 
  e_charts(x = date) |> 
  e_line(palaeoverse, symbol = "none") |> 
  e_line(sepkoski, symbol = "none") |> 
  e_line(rmacrostrat, symbol = "none") |> 
  e_line(rphylopic, symbol = "none") |> 
  e_legend(top = 0) |>
  e_grid(left = "5%", top = "10%", right = "5%") |> 
  e_tooltip(trigger = "axis") |>
  e_datazoom(type = "slider") |> 
  e_toolbox(show = FALSE) 
```

```{r}
#| title: Cumulative number of GitHub stars
series <- lapply(pkgs, function(pkg) {
  out <- package_time_series(pkg)[["github_stars"]][c("date", "value")]
  names(out)[2] <- pkg
  out
})

Reduce(function(x, y) full_join(x, y, by = "date"), series) |>
  arrange(date) |> 
  fill(palaeoverse, sepkoski, rmacrostrat, rphylopic, .direction = "down") |> 
  e_charts(x = date) |> 
  e_line(palaeoverse, symbol = "none") |> 
  e_line(sepkoski, symbol = "none") |> 
  e_line(rmacrostrat, symbol = "none") |> 
  e_line(rphylopic, symbol = "none") |> 
  e_legend(top = 0) |>
  e_grid(left = "5%", top = "10%", right = "5%") |> 
  e_tooltip(trigger = "axis") |>
  e_datazoom(type = "slider") |> 
  e_toolbox(show = FALSE)
```
